title: Robotics lab project series for CS1
summary: Students complete individual and team robotics labs that replace three web-development labs and culminate in public demonstrations and reflection. GenAI is treated like peer collaboration: high-level help is permitted, but generating a complete solution is plagiarism.

sources.title: Enhancing CS1 Education through Experiential Learning with Robotics Projects
sources.evidence_quote: Assignments are to be completed individually, with high-level collaboration encouraged. In this course, no distinction is made between collaboration with peers and the use of LLM-based chatbots.
